# Seyko Studios

> Demand intelligence for plastic surgery practices.

Seyko Studios is an independent demand intelligence partner for plastic surgery practices. The company focuses only on plastic surgery practices and helps owners see what patients are asking, how nearby surgeons earn trust, and where qualified consults may be hesitating.

Operating note:
- Made in Los Angeles
- Currently working with 3 active practices
- 2 open partner slots

Primary page:
- https://seykostudios.com/

Core services:
- Short Demand Radar breakdown
- Demand Radar Diagnostic
- Ongoing Demand Radar
- Multi-Location Group
- Patient demand read
- Competitor read
- Consult hesitation review
- More consult opportunities
- Procedure page priorities
- Consult economics
- Revenue context

Audience:
- Founder-led and platform plastic surgery practices
- Plastic surgery teams evaluating patient acquisition strategy, procedure demand, consult hesitation, pricing uncertainty, competitive positioning, and revenue performance

Offer ladder:
- Free short Demand Radar breakdown
- $5k-$8k one-time Demand Radar Diagnostic, delivered in 7 days
- $10k/mo Ongoing Demand Radar for a monthly market read, 6-month minimum
- $18k-$28k/mo Multi-Location Group for premium multi-location and multi-surgeon practices, 6-month minimum

Contact:
- partners@seykostudios.com
